title: Engagement cakes for Rosehill and Camellia families, 100% eggless
summary:
Planning an engagement party in Rosehill or Camellia and want a cake that's genuinely eggless, not egg-free "if you ask"? Harris Park has baked 100% eggless since 2019. No eggs in the sponge, the buttercream, or the ganache. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, any design from a photo reference.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Pickup from Wigram Street, a short drive from Rosehill and Camellia, open until 10pm daily if the evening runs long.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
